metadata.source: documented constraints from existing Voynich analysis
metadata.note: These are the observed structural facts about Currier B, documented in the constraint system. PCI-V2 does not re-measure them — it uses these documented values to score the candidate classes.

F1.name: Forbidden transitions (directional)
F1.evidence: 17 disfavored transitions at O/E<0.5, directional, ~65% compliance (C789, C109)

F2.name: Kernel convergence structure
F2.evidence: k/h/e kernel with recovery pathways (C085, C089)

F9.name: Cross-line independence (MI=0)
F9.evidence: MI=0.0172 bits (near-zero); lines are independent safety envelopes (C1470-C1471)

F10.name: Folio atom homogeneity
F10.evidence: Per-folio atom JSD ~0.019 vs corpus; low folio-to-folio variance

F11.name: Heaps beta high
F11.evidence: Heaps beta = 0.74 for Currier B (above natural language 0.5-0.7 range)

F13.name: High atom MI (vs NL chars)
F13.evidence: Adjacent atom MI 1.65 bits vs 0.65 for English/Latin chars (2.5x)

F14.name: Mode A/B alternation
F14.evidence: ~80% within-paragraph alternation of two suffix modes (C1229, C1341)
